content.text:
Two observations stand out: the session carried a very large context, and it repeated some searches. It also drifted into plan-level work after the fix was already in place.

- **Context:** peak context reached 257k tokens and 56 turns ran above 200k. About 140k tokens were spent before the first edit (turn 83). Fourteen files were re-read. The reads of `checks.py`, the hand-off and the specs were large and repeated.
- **Repeated searches:** the same id-shape grep ran three times at turns 89-91 and three more times at turns 129-133. A grep at turn 149 used look-around, which the search tool rejects, so it had to be redone at turn 153.
- **Scope drift:** the fix for the rejected finding was in place at turn 83. Turns 98-119 re-verified the hand-off's claims about tests and outcome lines. Turns 195-214 looked up the lint command and edited the hand-off's plan hints. Both go beyond closing the gaps in the triage note.
- **Prompt edit:** the fix edited `prompts/code.md`, a prompt file, even though the step is described as writing documents only. I cannot tell from the cut intent whether that was permitted.
- **Header items:** the header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagents, so the conformance list below covers only the two instructions I can see in the intent.

```json
{"observations": [
{"category": "context_bloat", "turns": [20, 46, 75, 156, 158], "remedy_class": "flow", "confidence": 0.6,
 "note": "Context peaked at 257k tokens with 56 turns above 200k and about 140k tokens spent before the first edit, with large files such as checks.py and the hand-off re-read repeatedly."},
{"category": "tool_thrash", "turns": [89, 90, 91, 129, 130, 133, 149, 153], "remedy_class": "tools", "confidence": 0.55,
 "note": "The same id-shape grep was run three times at 89-91 and three times at 129-133, and a look-around regex at 149 failed because the search tool does not support it."},
{"category": "wasted_turns", "turns": [98, 113, 195, 200, 208, 211, 214], "remedy_class": "prompt", "confidence": 0.5,
 "note": "After the fix landed at turn 83 the session kept re-verifying the hand-off's test claims and researching a lint command to adjust plan hints, which goes beyond closing the triage gaps."}
],
"conformance": [
{"item": "Close every gap with a document in the agreed format, and nothing more", "status": "unclear", "turns": [83, 211, 214]},
{"item": "You write documents only", "status": "unclear", "turns": [83, 122, 123]}
],
"none_found": false}
```
